findings.duplicate_prevention: Sufficient static design for cooperative canonical protocol entrants: stable flock plus durable exclusive attempt marker before spawn. Does not prove whole-host absence. Popen handle and logs provide owned-child lifecycle evidence, not independent mutual exclusion.
findings.time_protection: 60 s common monotonic deadline and per-process RLIMIT_CPU are reasonable bounded execution design, subject to implementation, scheduling, parent survival and confirmed child reaping. Not literal 60.000 s wall guarantee or aggregate process-tree CPU cap.
findings.memory: Polling ru_maxrss is delayed retrospective peak telemetry. RLIMIT_DATA covers data segment, not all allocations. SDK RLIMIT_RSS alias and setter success do not establish hard 1 GiB RSS enforcement. No allowed validated replacement established.
findings.permission_boundary: No full-system ps is required for scoped lock/owned-child lifecycle. Granting ps would not establish hard memory enforcement. No evidence that blocked permission is inherently necessary; actual missing capability remains worker-wide memory enforcement.

implementation_notes: Retain inherited lock descriptor via an explicit descriptor-passing path; never unlock or replace its inode while owned worker may be alive.
A worker must not reach SCIENCE_STARTED unless limits acknowledgement and remaining common deadline are valid.
At deadline terminate only the owned live child, follow with bounded escalation/reaping as needed, and record any unconfirmed stop as unresolved; never reuse persisted PID for cleanup.
Parent-death behavior and no-descendant path remain unvalidated; permanent attempt marker prevents restart but does not terminate an orphan.
Do not import scientific libraries or exercise solver/query workloads under the label of future engineering validation.
